question: Which of the following was the host to ICC U19 Cricket World Cup 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __West Indies.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points:__**

__
 
• The 2022 ICC Under-19 Cricket World Cup was held in West Indies in January and February 2022.
 
• Sixteen teams took part in it.
 
• It was the fourteenth edition of the Under-19 Cricket World Cup, and the first that was held in the West Indies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points:__**

__
 
• India win the 2022 U19 World Cup title, by beating England by 4 wickets.
 
• India clinched record-extending fifth U19 World Cup title in Antigua.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• The ICC Under-19 Cricket World Cup is an international cricket tournament organised by the International Cricket Council (ICC) contested by national under-19 teams.
 
• It was first contested in 1988, as the Youth World Cup.
 
• India, the most successful team at U19 World Cups, has won titles in 2000, 2008, 2012 and 2018 previously.
